import re
import random

def detect(cell):
    pattern = re.compile(r'^(\d+[\s]?user)?(,\s?(\d+[\s]?critic)?)?$')
    return not bool(pattern.fullmatch(cell))

def corrupt(cell):
    if not detect(cell):
        methods = [
            lambda c: re.sub(r'(\d+)', lambda m: str(int(m.group(0)) + random.randint(-2, 2)), c),  # Add random noise to numbers
            lambda c: re.sub(r'(user|critic)', lambda m: m.group(0).capitalize(), c),  # Capitalize randomly
            lambda c: re.sub(r'\d+', '', cell),  # Remove numbers
            lambda c: re.sub(r'(user|critic)', '', cell),  # Remove the units
            lambda c: re.sub(r',', '', cell),  # Remove commas
            lambda c: re.sub(r' ', '', cell)  # Remove spaces
        ]
        cell = random.choice(methods)(cell)
    return cell
